comparison.objective: Candidate commissions a robot-axis damper; record locks out a machine START pushbutton with a cover and padlock.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate combines recessed tool alignment, setscrew operation, fine collar rotation, counterholding, and dynamic testing; record installs a cover and padlock around a pushbutton.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate measures stopping travel, rebound, overload, hard-stop contact, and drift. Record requires pushbutton lockout but provides no specs or detailed scoring thresholds.
comparison.reason: Installing a safety enclosure and padlock does not test calibrated rotary adjustment or dynamic deceleration.
